Jordan — drafting the short answers now. High-level items to include when we send back to Alex: 

- SOC 2: we can share the full Type II report for 2025 after a standard viewer NDA; we can also provide the summary slide deck without redaction. Recommend sending the summary + playbook excerpt initially and offer the full report behind an NDA if procurement needs it.

- Incident response / breach notification: our standard timeline is: initial triage within 4 hours of detection, internal escalation to CSIRT within 8 hours, customer notification within 72 hours for confirmed customer-impacting incidents (we'll note exceptions for legal/regulatory reporting windows). For severe PII/PHI exposures we escalate to 24-hour executive notification and coordinate regulatory reporting.

- BCP/DR evidence: we typically provide the DR runbook excerpt (RTO/RPO targets per service) and recent tabletop exercise summary. For FinTechCorp request specifically, we should include RTO targets for the inference API (e.g., RTO < 4 hours for control-plane failover, degraded-mode serving for 99th percentile requests).

I will attach the playbook excerpt and an IR contact list. Rishi, can you add the escalation phone numbers and the CSIRT mailing list?

Marissa
Director, Security & Trust | Redwood Inference
